caption: The drawing features four rectangular swatches of patterned fabric, arranged in a two-by-two grid on a plain, off-white background. The top left swatch has a light beige background with a repeating pattern of small blue and darker blue triangular shapes. The top right swatch shows a pale pink or beige background with a repeating motif of white birds and red accents. The bottom left swatch displays a light tan background with a pattern of abstract red shapes and dots. The bottom right swatch has a similarly pale tan background with a design of black fan or plant motifs on it. Below the grid of swatches, the name "Frances D. Bruner" is handwritten in black ink.
title: Printed Textiles
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
